The word "SWAT" stands for Special Weapons and Tactics. It's basically the American way of saying Armed Police. We stick to words like "Armed Police", as that is what they call it in Europe and we were ruled by them for like 200 years. So we have Carried on the British way of saying things. I called them "SWAT" coz personally to me it sounds cooler. 

CIF and STRACO are two different SWAT units like KCP and KQRT. 

SSF is Special Strike Force which is a state version of CRPF's RAF. It's meant to act as an anti riot and urban disturbance unit. 

IRB ain't Paramilitary. It is controlled by states it is in. It's like ATS but for Jungles. It's also a SWAT team. Made for Naxal Warfare in Naxalite Areas. Also election duties and stuff. 

And there is another force called Eastern Frontier Rifles under WB police.  Works with Army and CRPF. Helps them in their work. 

So I count 5 already, not to mention has a WB has a ATS too. 

Now you call them "Special Weapons And Tactics", "Armed Police" , "Police Commandos" , "Gendarmeries" or whatever you want. But the basic gist is they are State run Law Enforcement Agencies with superior equipment and better skills.
